findings.rationale: Accepted: the "builder re-adds defaults" sentence was wrong — the builder only normalizes and stays byte-identical. §1.3 now states the floor has one enforcement site (the review.js spread), the review-runner case reads the built MANIFEST deny_list and asserts all eight defaults, and scope-integrity greps that buildReviewPacket( is called from review.js only; §6 reworded.

Accepted: the character allowlist was a second grammar and is removed. The shell checks exactly the six otherGlobSyntax rules (review-packet.js:95-104) — spaces, +, @, ~, non-ASCII are ACCEPTED by both sides — and JSON-escapes \ and " on emission; the oracle table gains accepted probes (space/+/@/~/non-ASCII) and refused/escaped probes (", \, a//b, trailing /), comparing emitted element as well as accept/reject.
Accepted: platforms/codex/plugin/project-config-template/review-loop-config.md exists at base and is now the 20th sealed path (seven pairs); max_changed_files 21.

Accepted: call sites pass the roster value verbatim; reviewPacketIdentity treats only undefined as absent ⇒ []; null/""/0/false/object/non-string element → prepare_review block "packet deny extra malformed".

Accepted: no stub — review.js requires the builder inline (:222) so the review-runner cases use the REAL builder on a temp git fixture and read MANIFEST.json; the JS resolver validates normalizeDenyList([element]) per element for the index; both resolvers emit the list as given (no sort/dedupe; normalization is the builder's), test wording changed to "echoed as given".

Accepted: the full 229-byte Context string is written out with Status open, and v2.36.64 is stated as a release-commit pin that depth-0 re-stamps if the number differs (1b-A/1b-B convention); CHANGELOG/version manifests are not sealed.
